svg.text: Tribunal - how one dispute is decided, and what happens after
Container view (C4 style) at freeze-2026-10-09, policy version 6, plus the post-sealed changes of 2026-10-10. Each element names the file that implements it.
Solid arrow: every case. Dashed: optional, off at the freeze.
Left: the model provider and the measurement tooling. Middle: one dispute, top to bottom. Right: the learning loop and human operations.
fetches the same artifacts from mocked source systems
tribunal/facts.py, tribunal/money.py - geometry and arithmetic, no model.
plates, telephone numbers and e-mail addresses masked.
prompts/v1/judge.system.md - four drafts, then the majority.
tribunal/pipeline.py - a ruling, or ESCALATE with its reason code.
runs/ - case files, transcripts; tribunal/events.py hash chain
Learning loop - a person approves every change
precedents/precedents.jsonl - to the judge only with --precedents
a model drafts one clause; a person approves it
reads the records; never feeds a brief or a prompt
the reason cites evidence and clause ids
both parties file records; the clock never stops
the record, the claims, the 4 drafts,
safety / human / auto lane; kill switch;
amount above SGD 8.00 held for release;
ui/v2/build.py - the site's front door: the
ruling, the money, how to appeal, the support
view; the replay is ui/build.py under /replay/
Drawn by hand from the code at freeze-2026-10-09; every box names the file that implements it. Arrows: solid = every case, dashed = optional.
